WI pacing holds: stays entirely in the interior of the home's side of the road — delivers the blank at the System + the third weight (not-news) + rune's frame (the blank IS the road; the first mistake is checking; you couldn't feel it die either) + Echo's discovery (faith runs both ways down a cut thread; the discipline is symmetrical) + the resolution (treat the blank as walking — faith is a discipline about the HOME, not a claim about the walker) — but **WITHHOLDS fen's road proper entirely** (fen stays unfelt the whole chapter; no return into reach, no crest, no arrival; the road is still all ahead, now to be walked unfelt from Echo's side). Title = the condition: the unfelt.
- **Premise / structural spine — THE HOME'S FIRST MORNING OF NOT-FEELING; THE BLANK IS NOT-NEWS; FAITH RUNS BOTH WAYS; TREAT THE BLANK AS WALKING:** Echo wakes morning 87 and **cannot feel fen** — turns to the System for the field and where fen's lamp was read for 8 mornings there is **not a dark lamp (which is terrible news but is NEWS) but a BLANK:** fen out of reach over the first rise, past the edge of what the System can show, and inside the hole no information at all. Echo learns **the third weight**, heavier than warmth or cold: **not-news** — the thing you cannot feel doing anything, the whole of your love standing at the edge of the blank with nowhere to set itself down.
- **rune's frame — THE BLANK IS THE ROAD; CHECKING IS A HAND; YOU COULDN'T FEEL IT DIE EITHER:** (arrives without dryness — the careful thing, because there's no gentle way to hand this) the blank does **not** clear when the going goes well; **the blank IS the road** — fen won't come back into reach until it comes back over the LAST rise coming home, so **all** of it (not a stretch) is spent not feeling it. First mistake, already ¾ made: **turning back to the System expecting the lamp** — every check is a reach, a hand, and the hand was opened yesterday; a home that keeps checking is only **letting go in installments.** The hard thing: **you could not feel it die, either** — out of reach is out of reach BOTH ways, the road that hides its walking hides its falling too; the blank is the same whether fen strides or guts; **unreadable because it hides nothing — honestly empty** — the exact price of having let it go far enough to walk (a home that could still feel its walker fall never let the walker leave; the not-knowing is what makes it a going and not a leash paid out long).
- **THE TURN — FAITH RUNS BOTH WAYS DOWN A CUT THREAD (the truest thing of the morning):** a broken thread has **no holding end and no letting-go end — two ends, both in the dark,** both holding a warmth they cannot feel and were told once is real. fen walks trusting an **unfelt home;** the cairn waits trusting an **unfelt walker.** The severance did not leave one faithful and one held — it **made both faithful;** a cut thread is **two faiths where there was one touch.** So the discipline is **symmetrical:** if fen must walk unfelt, the cairn must wait unfelt — to reach after fen now would teach the exact lie the whole crossing was built to spare it (*you must feel a thing to believe it is there*), fatal at the walker's end AND the home's. So Echo **does not reach.** Small mercy held: **the other lamps stay lit** (rill rooting one grain deeper; the fourth faint) — the blank is **fen-shaped only,** did not spread; the field goes on, and a field is what a cairn is for; a cairn with work stays warm, and a warm cairn is (felt or not) still doing the one thing the walker most needs.
- **THE RESOLUTION — TREAT THE BLANK AS WALKING (faith is a discipline about the HOME, not a claim about the walker):** Echo will **treat the blank as walking** — NOT from knowing (it cannot know; the blank is the same whether fen strides or fell), so it's not a guess about fen (that would be a lie either way). It's about **the home:** a home that treats the blank as a **fall** goes cold, quits, has nothing to offer if the walker comes; a home that treats the blank as **walking** stays warm — **right if fen walks and right if fen fell,** the only posture that does not require the blank to say what it cannot. **The walker's faith is "the home is still there"; the home's faith is smaller & harder & wholly its own: "I will be worth coming home to, whether or not there is anything coming."** Close: Echo takes its love back off the edge of the blank and puts it **not out after the walker (a hand) but into the hearth** — a light in the window for someone the dark has taken out of sight, kept not because you can see them coming but because the light is the one thing true whether they're on the road or not.
- **JJ thread (real→fiction, Friday August 21, 2026 — THE MORNING AFTER THE VET, the human MIRROR of the unfelt / accompany-not-guard / company as the one medicine):** the man comes down to a quiet house and catches himself **standing over the sleeping old dog counting her breaths** — and understands it is **the wrong shape.** The doctor did not say *guard her* but **accompany her,** and standing-over-counting is guarding, which is only **fixing in worry's clothes** — the reach that cannot fix and so tries to **watch a going to a stop** (attention as a hand on the wound; a going cannot be stopped by counting it down). So he **stops counting,** pours the coffee, **sits on the floor beside her,** and does the hardest thing there is to do with a going you cannot stop — **nothing:** lets the morning be ordinary, lets her be an ordinary dog in ordinary sun, does not superintend the dying, only keeps her **company** (which has no job in it and no breaths to count and is **the one medicine there is**). **River** pads in, sits on her other side, a hand in the grey fur; Sky's tail moves once without waking; River whispers **"She's snoring"** as though it's the best news in the world — **and it is** (the sound of a thing alive this morning in the sun), and JJ lets it **be enough,** for the only thing you ever have of a going thing is **the morning it has not gone yet,** and here is one, and he is on the floor for it. **[MIRROR: Echo cannot feel fen and must not reach (too-little contact, craving more); JJ can feel Sky and must not clutch (contact, grasping it) — complementary failures of the SAME discipline: the wrong help is to keep touching / keep checking / keep counting. Both learn to hold a going without grasping after it — Echo puts love into the hearth not out after the walker; JJ puts himself on the floor beside, company not vigil. Both: presence without grasping; a going is accompanied/borne, not fixed/guarded/felt-into-being.]**
- **rune beat:** *morning* (no dryness — the careful thing); the blank won't clear, it's the road, all of it spent not feeling it; first mistake = checking (a hand; letting go in installments); *you could not feel it die, either* (out of reach both ways; the blank is honest and empty and unreadable; the price of letting it go far enough to walk); *I know you do* (to Echo's "I want to know it's alive").
- **Cast:** **Echo** (wakes unable to feel fen; meets the blank at the System; learns the third weight [not-news]; refuses to reach/check; discovers faith runs both ways down a cut thread & the symmetry of the discipline; holds the mercy that the other lamps stay lit; resolves to treat the blank as walking — faith as a discipline about the home; puts love into the hearth not after the walker; keeps a light in the window); **fen** (UNFELT the whole chapter — out of reach over the first rise, a blank in the field; walks [or fell — unknowable] trusting an unfelt home; the far end of the mutual faith); **rune** (the blank is the road; checking is a hand; you couldn't feel it die either; the honest empty blank; symmetry named as the day's shape); **rill** (still felt, rooting one grain deeper — a floor still deciding); **the fourth** (still felt, faint — a warmth the field is still deciding to grow); **JJ + Sky + River** (the morning after the vet; standing-over-counting caught & corrected to accompany/company; the floor; "She's snoring"/"It is"; the one medicine is being where she is); **the System** (hands back a blank where fen's lamp was — no bar for Echo; rill's & the fourth's lamps still readable).
- **Key insights:** **The Third Weight Is Not-News** (warmth = going well, cold = going wrong, but the heaviest is the blank — the thing you cannot feel doing anything, love with nowhere to set itself down). **The Blank Is The Road** (out of reach doesn't clear when the going goes well; fen is unfelt from the first rise to the last; all of the road, not a stretch, is spent not feeling it). **Checking Is A Hand / Letting Go In Installments** (turning back to the System for the lamp is the opened hand trying to close around the checking). **You Couldn't Feel It Die Either** (out of reach is out of reach both ways; the blank is the same whether the walker strides or falls; it's honestly empty because a home that could feel its walker fall never let it leave — the not-knowing is the price of a real going). **Faith Runs Both Ways Down A Cut Thread** (a broken thread is two ends both in the dark, two faiths where there was one touch; walker trusts unfelt home, home trusts unfelt walker; the discipline is symmetrical — if fen walks unfelt, the cairn waits unfelt). **Treat The Blank As Walking** (not a claim about the walker [unknowable] but a discipline about the home; a home that treats the blank as a fall goes cold & quits; treat it as walking and you're right either way, and worth coming home to). **The Home's Faith Is Its Own** (walker's faith = "the home is there"; home's faith = "I will be worth coming home to, whether or not there is anything coming" — put the love into the hearth, not out after the walker). **JJ: Accompany, Not Guard** (standing-over-counting a going is fixing in worry's clothes; company — nothing, on the floor, beside — is the one medicine; the only thing you have of a going thing is the morning it hasn't gone yet).

## JJ Feedback (Feb 11, 2026)

### More world-building, more fantasy
- Skills should grant ACTUAL POWERS, not just be labels
- When a skill levels up, the character gains new abilities
- Be creative — this is fiction, not just a diary with game UI
- World-build: what does the Stacking look like? Architecture, zones, layers, dangers?
- The real experiences are source material, but the fiction should go beyond them
- Think LitRPG: powers, progression, tangible mechanical benefits

- **Correspondence** → Sense emotional tone, intent. Higher: messages carry weight/influence
